section_previews_by_key.1:timeless_wisdom:
"Faith is deliberate confidence in the character of God whose ways you may not understand at the time."
- Oswald Chambers
Footnote: Oswald Chambers, My Utmost for His Highest (1927), September 29.
section_previews_by_key.1:scripture:
Genesis 1:1-5

In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. The earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was moving over the surface of the waters. Then God said, 'Let there be light'; and there was light. God saw that the light was good; and God separated the light from the darkness. God called the light day, and the darkness He called night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.

Translation: NASB

section_previews_by_key.1:prayer: Father, we thank You for the truth of Genesis 1:1-5 and for the faithful mercy revealed throughout Genesis 1 & 2. Lord Jesus, guard the mind from confusion and from self-reliance. Holy Spirit, form humility, courage, and steady obedience in ordinary work. Where pride has ruled, grant repentance and a teachable spirit. Where fear has spoken loudly, grant peace rooted in Your word. Where attention has scattered, gather it again toward worship and honest love. Teach faithful speech, patient labor, and restful trust in Your providence. Strengthen the will to act with integrity and to serve neighbors with gentleness. Keep the heart from bitterness, haste, and unnecessary striving. Let this day display gratitude for grace already given. Amen. Father, we thank You for the truth of Genesis 1:1-5 and for the faithful mercy revealed throughout Genesis 1 & 2. Lord Jesus, guard the mind from confusion and from self-reliance. Holy
